templates.title: Studio portrait
templates.description: Head-and-shoulders portrait with soft, controlled studio light.

examples.person: a woman in her sixties with silver braids and laugh lines, warm half-smile

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Head-and-shoulders portrait of [person], wearing [clothing], against [background]. Soft key light from camera left through a large diffuser, gentle fill from the right, a faint hair light, 85 mm lens at f/2, eyes in sharp focus, natural skin texture.
defaults.negative: distorted hands, extra fingers, blurry eyes, heavy retouching, plastic skin

templates.title: Portrait at work
templates.description: Someone in their own workplace, tools in hand, documentary light.

examples.person: a Pakistani truck-art painter in his fifties with a grey beard and paint-flecked kurta
examples.workplace: a Karachi yard beside a truck covered in bright floral truck art
examples.tool: a fine brush loaded with bright yellow paint

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Environmental portrait of [person] in [workplace], holding [tool] and looking into the lens. Daylight from a side doorway, 35 mm lens at chest height, medium shot, the workplace softly visible behind, honest documentary feel.
defaults.negative: posed stock-photo smile, extra fingers, cluttered foreground, oversaturated

templates.title: Golden-hour portrait
templates.description: Outdoor portrait backlit by a low sun, warm rim light and soft bokeh.

examples.person: a young Moroccan man in a loose white linen shirt
examples.location: a rooftop terrace overlooking the old medina of Fes

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Outdoor portrait of [person] on [location] at golden hour. The low sun sits behind them and draws a warm rim light along the hair and shoulders, soft bounce fill on the face, 85 mm lens, creamy background bokeh, relaxed natural pose.
defaults.negative: lens flare covering the face, blown-out sky, distorted hands

templates.title: Product hero shot
templates.description: A clean studio hero image of one product for a shop or an ad.

examples.product: a matte black stainless-steel water bottle

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Hero shot of [product] standing on [surface] in front of a [backdrop colour] seamless backdrop. Three-quarter angle, soft diffused key light from above left, a crisp rim light tracing the edges, a subtle reflection underneath, generous empty space on one side for copy.
defaults.negative: text, watermark, clutter, warped label, duplicate product

templates.title: Product in use
templates.description: Lifestyle advert photo: the product in a real home, a person in soft focus.

examples.product: a white ceramic pour-over coffee set
examples.setting: a sunlit Istanbul apartment kitchen with patterned blue tiles
examples.action: a woman's hands pouring hot water from a gooseneck kettle

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Lifestyle advert photo of [product] in [setting], [action], the product sharp in the foreground and everything else gently out of focus. Late-morning window light, 50 mm lens, warm natural tones, uncluttered styling.
defaults.negative: text, logo distortion, messy background, extra fingers

templates.title: Flat-lay ad
templates.description: Top-down styled arrangement of a product and props, editorial look.

examples.product: a skincare serum in an amber glass dropper bottle
examples.props: sprigs of rosemary, lemon slices and smooth river stones

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Top-down flat lay of [product] surrounded by [props], arranged loosely on [background]. Even soft daylight, gentle shadows falling to the lower right, clean margins, editorial advertising style.
defaults.negative: text, watermark, cluttered, tilted perspective

templates.title: Overhead feast
templates.description: An appetising dish shot from above for a menu, a blog or an ad.

examples.dish: chicken biryani with saffron rice, crisp fried onions and halved boiled eggs

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Overhead food photograph of [dish] served on [tableware] on a [table surface] table. Garnish scattered naturally, small side bowls at the edges of the frame, soft daylight from one side, a wisp of steam, shallow depth of field.
defaults.negative: plastic-looking food, messy plate, harsh flash, cutlery in the centre

templates.title: Moody food close-up
templates.description: Dramatic dark-background close-up that makes textures glisten.

examples.detail: golden syrup dripping slowly from the top piece

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Close-up food photograph of [dish] on [plate], shot at 45 degrees against a near-black background, [detail]. One hard side light that makes every texture glisten, 100 mm macro lens, very shallow depth of field.
defaults.negative: flat lighting, cluttered background, artificial colours

templates.title: Fashion editorial
templates.description: A bold full-length magazine shot on location in hard sunlight.

examples.outfit: an oversized cream linen suit with wide trousers and a silk scarf
examples.location: the pink sandstone steps of a stepwell in Jaipur

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Full-length fashion editorial photograph of a model wearing [outfit], posed on [location]. Hard midday sun with crisp graphic shadows, 35 mm lens from a low angle, bold geometric composition, confident pose, magazine styling.
defaults.negative: distorted hands, cropped feet, extra limbs, blurry fabric

templates.title: Studio lookbook
templates.description: Clean full-body catalogue shot against a paper backdrop.

examples.model: a tall woman with short natural hair
examples.outfit: an emerald green shalwar kameez with gold thread embroidery and a sheer dupatta

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Studio lookbook photograph of [model] wearing [outfit], standing against a [backdrop] paper backdrop. Soft diffused key light, gentle even fill, full body with feet visible, clean catalogue framing, true-to-life fabric colour.
defaults.negative: cropped feet, wrinkled backdrop, extra fingers, warped pattern

templates.title: Interior design shot
templates.description: A calm, magazine-ready room with straight verticals and daylight.

examples.key feature: a low oak bench and a paper lantern beside a wide linen sofa

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Interior design photograph of a [room] in [style] style, with [key feature]. Soft daylight through tall windows, one-point perspective from chest height, 24 mm lens with straight verticals, calm and uncluttered, natural materials.
defaults.negative: converging verticals, clutter, people, fisheye distortion

templates.title: Building at blue hour
templates.description: Architectural exterior with tilt-shift geometry and glowing windows.

examples.building: a modern mosque with a white concrete dome and a slender minaret
examples.setting: a quiet plaza lined with olive trees

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Architectural photograph of [building] in [setting] at blue hour, interior lights glowing warm against a deep blue sky. Low corner angle, 24 mm tilt-shift lens with perfectly straight verticals, a few small figures for scale, clean reflections on wet stone.
defaults.negative: converging verticals, crowds, lens distortion, oversaturated

templates.title: Grand landscape
templates.description: A wide scenic view for backgrounds, establishing shots or prints.

examples.place: the Hunza Valley with snow-capped Rakaposhi in the distance

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Wide landscape of [place] at [time of day]. A foreground of [foreground] leading the eye into the scene, layered ridges fading into atmospheric haze, natural colour, 24 mm lens, deep focus.
defaults.negative: people, text, oversaturated sky, HDR halos

templates.title: Travel street scene
templates.description: A lively street at dusk, candid and warm, for travel stories.

examples.street life: a yellow tram climbing the hill past people on café terraces

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Travel photograph of a street in [city] at dusk, [street life]. Warm shop lights against a fading violet sky, 35 mm lens at eye level, leading lines running up the street, candid and lively.
defaults.negative: distorted faces, garbled signs, tilted horizon

templates.title: Aerial view
templates.description: Drone-height view where the land makes its own patterns.

examples.place: the rolling dunes of the Wahiba Sands in Oman
examples.detail: a lone camel caravan casting long thin shadows

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Aerial drone photograph looking straight down at [place], with [detail]. Low late-afternoon sun raking across the surface, bold abstract patterns of light and shadow, crisp detail, minimal colour palette.
defaults.negative: horizon, haze, text, oversaturated

templates.title: Film poster with title
templates.description: Key art with a legible title and tagline. Uses Qwen-Image for the lettering.

examples.TITLE: THE LAST MONSOON
examples.central image: A lone woman with a black umbrella on a flooded Lahore street at night

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Cinematic film poster with the title "[TITLE]" in large bold serif letters across the top and the line "[tagline]" in small type at the bottom. [central image], dramatic rim lighting, a strong silhouette, [palette] colour palette.
defaults.negative: garbled text, misspelled words, watermark, cluttered composition

templates.title: Urdu greeting poster
templates.description: A festive greeting card with Urdu lettering for Eid or a wedding. Urdu spelling is hit-and-miss: make a few and pick.

examples.motif: a crescent moon and three hanging brass lanterns
examples.background: a deep emerald green background with a subtle gold geometric pattern

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Festive greeting poster with the Urdu text "[Urdu greeting]" written once, in large clear gold Arabic-script lettering centred in the upper half, every letter exact. Below it [motif], on [background]. Symmetric layout, soft warm glow, print-ready.
defaults.negative: garbled letters, Latin text, broken calligraphy, watermark

templates.title: Urdu event poster
templates.description: Poetry night or book launch poster with an Urdu heading. Keep the Urdu short and make a few to pick from.

examples.visual: an antique brass oil lamp beside a reed pen on aged paper

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Event poster with the Urdu heading "[Urdu title]" written once, in large clear cream Arabic-script lettering at the top, every letter exact, and the English line "[details]" in small clean capitals at the bottom. In the centre, [visual], lit by warm candlelight against a dark maroon background. Elegant, balanced, print-ready.
defaults.negative: garbled letters, misspelled words, cluttered layout, watermark

templates.title: Gig flyer
templates.description: A loud two-colour risograph-style flyer with a big headline.

examples.headline: NIGHT JAZZ
examples.visual: A saxophonist silhouetted in a spotlight

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Bold concert flyer with the headline "[headline]" in huge condensed letters and "[details]" underneath in small caps. [visual], halftone texture, two-colour risograph print look in [colours], slight misregistration, strong graphic layout.
defaults.negative: garbled text, extra words, photographic, muddy colours

templates.title: Video thumbnail
templates.description: High-contrast thumbnail with a reaction face and a few huge words.

examples.person: a young South Asian food vlogger with wide eyes, pointing
examples.subject: a giant plate of street-style papdi chaat

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Video thumbnail: [person] on the right of the frame, [subject] on the left, and the text "[thumbnail text]" in huge white letters with a thick black outline in a clear band above everyone's heads. Bright saturated colours, high contrast, clean simple background, punchy and readable at small size.
defaults.negative: garbled text, extra words, cluttered background, distorted face

templates.title: Minimal social post
templates.description: A square, scroll-stopping still life with soft pastel colour.

examples.subject: a single scoop of mango sorbet in a glass coupe with a mint leaf

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Square social media photo of [subject], centred with plenty of clean space around it, [palette] pastel palette, soft diffused light, a gentle shadow, minimalist aesthetic.
defaults.negative: text, clutter, harsh shadows, busy background

templates.title: Watercolour illustration
templates.description: Loose storybook watercolour with ink lines and paper texture.

examples.scene: a cat asleep on a sunny windowsill of a blue-and-white house in Sidi Bou Said

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Loose watercolour illustration of [scene], soft wet-in-wet washes, fine ink linework, [palette] palette, white paper texture showing at the edges, gentle storybook feel.
defaults.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, text, muddy colours

templates.title: Miniature painting
templates.description: A modern scene told in the manner of a classical South Asian miniature.

examples.scene: a young woman cycling through a palace garden of fountains and cypress trees
examples.palette: lapis blue, saffron and leaf green

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Painting in the manner of a classical Mughal miniature: [scene]. Flat tilted perspective, delicate outlines, an ornate floral border, fine gold detailing, [palette] palette, opaque gouache on aged paper.
defaults.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, text, modern typography

templates.title: Isometric diorama
templates.description: A tiny, toy-like 3D scene on a floating tile.

examples.subject: a corner tea stall in Old Delhi
examples.details: steaming kettles, stacked glass cups, a bicycle and a sleeping dog

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Isometric 3D illustration of [subject] as a tiny diorama on a floating square tile, with [details]. Soft clay-like materials, gentle studio lighting with soft shadows, pastel background, charming and tidy.
defaults.negative: text, photorealistic, cluttered, harsh shadows

templates.title: Character sheet
templates.description: One character shown front, side and back on a plain background.

examples.character: a teenage girl courier with a short black bob and freckles
examples.outfit: a patched orange windbreaker, cargo shorts, high-top sneakers and a messenger bag

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Character reference sheet of [character], wearing [outfit]. Three full-body views side by side: front, side profile and back, same scale and neutral pose. Plain light grey background, flat even lighting, consistent colours and details in every view.
defaults.negative: different outfits between views, cropped feet, busy background, text

templates.title: Concept environment
templates.description: A painterly establishing view of an imagined world.

examples.environment: a floating desert city of sandstone towers and wind-catchers
examples.focal point: a caravan of patched airships docking at a high terrace

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Concept art of [environment], with [focal point] in the middle distance, [mood]. Volumetric light, layered atmospheric depth, painterly matte-painting finish, wide establishing view.
defaults.negative: text, watermark, flat lighting, cluttered foreground
